This supplement **is** the notebooks in this folder. Funder figures:

`scripts/main_traj_facet.R`. Shared engine: **FLBacktest**.

| Notebook | Role |
|----------|------|
| [`01.0_condition_om.Rmd`](01.0_condition_om.Rmd) | Operating Models |
| [`01.1_lterm_eq.Rmd`](01.1_lterm_eq.Rmd) | Long-term \(F_{\mathrm{MSY}}\) gate |
| [`01.2_dynamics.Rmd`](01.2_dynamics.Rmd) | Dynamics diagnostics |
| [`02.1_openLoop.Rmd`](02.1_openLoop.Rmd) | Open loop (ICES \(F_{\mathrm{tar}}\) and OM \(F_{\mathrm{MSY}}\)) |

| [`02.3_closedLoop_shortcut.Rmd`](02.3_closedLoop_shortcut.Rmd) | Short-cut OEM (`eqSimErr`) |
| [`02.4_closedLoop_sam.Rmd`](02.4_closedLoop_sam.Rmd) | SAM OEM, then SAM closed loop |
| [`02.5_rebuild.Rmd`](02.5_rebuild.Rmd) | 20-year Future |

Not here: screening, TwoStocks, generic scn2, parent `06.0_report.Rmd`.
Short-cut and SAM are off the funder knit:
`Rscript scripts/run_pipeline.R --only shortcut` and `--only sam`.
SAM stages via `BM_SAM_STAGE`: `fit`, then `loop`, then `srr`.
Closed-loop multi-SRR: `BM_CLOSED_SRR=all`.
